name: coop-spell-caster
description: Registered caster ownership for the original Flipendo shove and original Ch1 Lumos interaction; original single-player branches, projectile hit chain, light timer and trigger event state machine remain.
format_note: ASCII JSON. Encode old/new strings as latin-1; preserve LF source bytes. Apply only to a marked development copy via scripts/apply_patches.py.
scope: HChar.HandleSpellFlipendo retains original SP fallback; authority co-op uses registered projectile caster without rebinding enemy AI context.
gargoyle.HandleSpellLumos validates original projectile/wand/caster before its existing Green state and baseSpell OnSpellHit event chain.
Original LumosLight uses HPCoopWand.Owner before bootstrap, retains original finite/infinite timer, and delegates co-op visual notifications without global OnLumosOff.
Original LumosTrigger state machine and event flags remain; authority co-op radius checks consider every active registered owner light.
Original LumosSparkles effects run from the local viewport camera through a guarded simulated entrypoint; original SP states remain.
No proprietary maps/assets, Game/Harry code, broad AI behavior or active runtime tree are changed by this recipe.
known_gaps: firecrab.pushDirection still uses canonical PlayerHarry for subsequent ledge decisions.
Native Lumos surface visibility follows the local light-owning viewport pawn; a partner only sees their own native Lumos reveal, while authoritative opened doors are shared.
Full campaign Lumos choreography and optional infinite/script commands require separate runtime coverage.
Gargoyle animation and secret-door mover replication must be verified in the two-player first-map runtime.
